b: The next day we had to take a bus to Sapa …Everyone got ready late and we were late leaving.. That's exactly why I go everywhere half an hour early… None of the people I hang out with have this habit… I used to go to school at six because if I went late I'd get stuck in traffic… Same for campus… They joke that I'm the one who opens the gate… But however hard I try, I just can't go late

My bus was put at 2.30… I had to go alone… Since I'd done it once, I was quite brave… I got there just about at 2.. They'd said to come half an hour early… But there was no sign of a bus stopping at that place… Somehow I searched, found the bus office and went in

As soon as I showed my ticket she gave me a funny look.. I had a doubt right then… She called and talked to someone and then said you'll get a call, talk to them… Mithra had booked all my buses… She'd have given her number… The call would go to that, so I told her to give my number… I got worn out breaking my English into pieces so she'd understand… Somehow a call came to my number… On the other end, a woman too.. She spoke English a bit better… What she asked was why I'd given a different number… What is this trouble.. I didn't understand what this had to do with the bus… Then she asked what time I came, and I said 2… "Liar!" she leapt about on the phone.. Hearing the time I'd said, the shop woman too showed me the camera and scolded me as a liar… When I came in it was 2.09, apparently… In the hurry of looking for the bus I hadn't noticed any of this

I understood the bus had left, and when I asked, so has the bus gone, there was no answer to that question.. She kept asking again and again why I'd lied that it was two., and on the other side our people kept calling… I cut her call and told them what happened.. They were still waiting at another place for a different bus.. Mithra immediately booked me a ticket through that office so I'd come with them…

Terrible anger, sorrow … When I was little, if anyone scolded me, tears would come like a tank opening.. They'd tease that it's shameful for a boy to cry… But to this day it hasn't come right… It's a fear stamped deep in my mind from being scolded by someone often as a child… That child comes out often.. That day too… Somehow I found them, got on the bus with them, and then I cried… There's no answer to why I cried… Like this, on campus, whenever I broke down I'd call my friend… He'd understand what state of mind I was in… He should have become a psychiatrist… Talking to him put everything right

The bus was for the five of us .. a small AC bus .. they called it a limousine bus or something… In comfort like that we got off in the hill country of Sapa.. It was like Nuwara Eliya.. Drizzle… Even in that we got out, wandered round the town and went to the room
note: Nuwara Eliya is the cool hill-station town of Sri Lanka's tea country.
